LOW.label: Low Risk
LOW.description: Minimal structural anomaly; consistent with standard benign URL conventions.

GUARDED.label: Guarded Risk
GUARDED.description: Predominantly benign structure with isolated minor lexical or structural variations.
GUARDED.recommended_action: Allow with passive monitoring. Exercise caution if personal credentials are requested.

MODERATE.label: Moderate / Borderline Risk
MODERATE.description: Ambiguous lexical profile or borderline model confidence. Signals heightened uncertainty.
MODERATE.recommended_action: Heightened scrutiny required. Display contextual warning before user credential entry.

HIGH.label: High Risk
HIGH.description: Strong structural and lexical markers commonly associated with deceptive phishing links.
HIGH.recommended_action: Intervene with interstitial warning. Advise user against interacting with page elements.

CRITICAL.recommended_action: Block navigation immediately. Log link to enterprise security telemetry for threat triage.
